accommodation.description:
Karma Kandara blends traditional Balinese architecture with luxury amenities to create a series of private villas, each formed from pavilions arranged around their own tropical courtyard and private pool. The two, three and four-bedroom villas feature natural stone, teakwood decks and indigenous grass or ironwood tile roofs.

Karma’s Bali Price Match Guarantee. We do our best to always offer you the lowest price, but if you find a lower qualified price* on another site, we will be happy to match it. Please email the offer to our res@karmaresorts.com email address.

title: Karma Fushi
description: An isolated paradise in the Maldives featuring overwater bungalows, crystal clear turquoise waters, and world-class diving experiences.
